text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black 
failed to secure victory. Yet, everyone 
was left breathless by the sheer intensity 
of their limit-breaking battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though neither could win, the two praise 
each other for reaching even greater 
heights. Just then, a voice interrupts 
their conversation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio. 
Inspired by Satono Diamond and the others' 
running, they had come to declare a 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen announced her entry into 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), while Tokai Teio 
announced hers for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond wished to run in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). Taking her wish into 
account, her Trainer suggested the Kyoto 
Daishoten as a prep race.
